support_artifact.support_mapping: histogram onto the measured one-second/100-um grid; each frozen output channel's displaced 3-sigma source neighborhood must meet the support fraction gate

identity_correspondence.eligible_population: all baseline good clusters with at least one retained spike in the frozen interval and depth band
identity_correspondence.ambiguity_policy: reject a unit when more than one reciprocal candidate satisfies all criteria
identity_correspondence.unmatched_policy: remain in the eligible denominator and are not improvements

completeness.aggregation: median(baseline_missing_pct - candidate_missing_pct) over measurable reciprocal pairs; positive means the candidate has lower estimated missingness

verdicts.pass: coverage meets floor, completeness improvement meets margin, and no guardrail breaches
verdicts.fail: coverage meets floor and a measured primary or guardrail criterion fails
verdicts.inconclusive: a required denominator or measurement is unavailable; report the measured denominator and prerequisite

analysis_provenance.correction: The executed evaluator uses baseline_missing_pct - candidate_missing_pct, matching the production completeness gate. The initial report wording and amendment aggregation text said candidate minus baseline; this was corrected after the arms completed without changing thresholds, data, or acceptance criteria.
analysis_provenance.not_prospectively_frozen_claim: The endpoint code correction was post-execution; the corrected endpoint is an engineering recomputation of the completed artifacts, not a prospectively frozen candidate result.
